caption: The drawing features a depiction of a handcrafted object, possibly an embroidered or beaded pouch. The upper portion illustrates a landscape scene with a large green tree at the center, flanked on the left by a yellow house with a blue rooftop and on the right by two buildings in shades of pink and blue. A figure in blue clothing and a red hat is positioned on a light-colored path that leads up towards the right, passing between the buildings and the tree. The background behind these elements is filled with a lavender color, suggesting distant terrain or sky. The lower segment of the pouch displays a decorative band with a diagonal green leafy pattern, followed by a triangular area adorned with small blue and red floral dots on a light background. The bottom is finished with a fringe made of looped beads in green, pink, and blue, which dangles from the edge. The object is rendered against a plain, cream-colored background, and there is a small inscription with the name “Dobres. (A. Haupt)” in the lower right corner.
title: Knit Beaded Bag
